title: Interviews with Anakah and Tristan, two personalities in one body

tellings.quote: I've done a series of interviews with two individuals who exist in one body. They used the names Anakah and Tristan. I've now completed 10 interviews with Anakah and Tristan.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a PhD who studies psychic experiences and hosts an online channel called New Thinking Allowed, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a series of interviews he recorded between about 2024 and 2026. He says he has done ten interviews with two people, who go by Anakah and Tristan, who share one body. He shares this because, if true, it raises deep questions about what a person or a mind really is.
